newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MOMENTUM GAINS AS INSTITUTIONS SEE VALUE.
newsitem.headline: MOMENTUM GAINS AS INSTITUTIONS SEE VALUE.

text.p: Shares in life and pensions firm, Momentum Life Assurers, jumped almost nine percent on Thursday as institutional interest in the stock lifted it off recent lows, dealers said.
"It has basically come down to a level where our analyst felt it was offering value," a dealer on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.
"There are a few institutions out there which are also keen on the stock," he added.
By 1310 GMT Momentum was up 46 cents to 566 cents rising off Wednesday's closing price of 520 cents -- its lowest level in two months.
Just short of 750,000 shares had traded, more than half of which had been in a bookover deal, traders said.

Analysts said earlier this year they expected Momentum to show a sharp 40 to 50 percent leap in year results for the 12 months to end June on the back of growth in assets under management and a turnaround in subsidiary Aegis Insurance Co Ltd.
